dialogues.speaker: Record Penned by All
dialogues.text: "May the Wayob grant you peace, and may songs be sung of your life's journey."

dialogues.speaker: Record Penned by All
dialogues.text: (What follows is a list of names of the deceased, dense as a forest, written by those who mourn them. You see many a familiar name on it.)

dialogues.speaker: Record Penned by All
dialogues.text: "We give thanks for the gift of your life in ours. And we look forward to meeting you again one day, in a world of wonder and beauty."
